task_graph_cancellation_operator_entry.authority: The Secure Ingress committed claim and canonical audit row are re-resolved server-side. Their request, principal, tenant, action, scopes, body SHA-256, method, path, and ALLOW decision must match the exact graph revision and canonical Operator command body. claim_result_ref must still be absent; a settled authority cannot become a reusable in-process bearer. Callers cannot supply request identity or source.
task_graph_cancellation_operator_entry.routing: One verifier instance is injected into Host, Internal, and Scheduler runtimes. GovernedRuntimeGroup resolves the exact durable HostCommand surface and routes to that surface; OPERATOR is server-fixed. On downstream failure it re-reads the exact durable cancellation intent. Only a cancellation handler translation into the closed OBS port error contract can report definite non-execution; arbitrary dependency exceptions remain uncertain.
task_graph_cancellation_operator_entry.startup_boundary: Enabling the feature requires Secure Ingress ENFORCE plus an available enabled Operator Command Gateway; startup otherwise fails closed.

graph_cancellation_business_reconciliati.operation_path: The restricted signed service is constructed by ProcessTaskRuntimeContainer, registered in ASGI Operator Runtime state, exposed only through the scoped OBS command, and backed by verification-only Ed25519 public-key injection. Its feature flag is default off, startup requires Secure Ingress ENFORCE and an executable Gateway, and no production canary has run.
graph_cancellation_business_reconciliati.effect_path: WIRED_DEFAULT_OFF / CANARY_NOT_RUN. ProcessTaskRuntimeContainer constructs the restricted signed Effect service, ASGI registers it only behind its default-off feature flag, and OBS exposes the scoped command. Three read-only routes require exact obs:task-runtime:read; generic obs:operator:read is denied. The dedicated Obs process composes a query-only facade over the same canonical SQLite file only when HOST_NLE_OPERATOR_VIEWS_ENABLED=true, using mode=ro plus PRAGMA query_only without constructing DurableTaskStore or a UoW. Public summaries are minimized, while exact subject material is transported as canonical-JSON base64url plus digest for the signer. Verification-only Ed25519 public keys are injected; this proves wiring, not deployed credentials, key lifecycle, or production enablement.
graph_cancellation_business_reconciliati.effect_failure_boundary: A general Acceptance Effect FAILED status cannot prove that no external side effect occurred. New cancellation requests and concurrent handler/transport failures keep the effect fence at RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED. Only COMMITTED with a durable receipt may resolve automatically as COMMITTED_EVIDENCE. The request classifier additionally distinguishes the exact virgin PENDING tuple (attempt_count=0, fencing_token=0, status_version=0, reason_code/last_error absent) from canonical retry PENDING. Under current authority a retry PENDING that is eligible for a cancellation fence is not reachable through production APIs: claim requires an ACCEPTED NODE, which cancellation excludes, or a COMPLETED GRAPH, which is terminal. The retry classification is therefore legacy/corruption hardening and fails closed as RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED, not a normal reschedule/cancellation race.
graph_cancellation_business_reconciliati.effect_reconciliation_boundary: Migration 0098 is append-only: it never rewrites the 0087 Effect row, 0092 fence, or an immutable cancellation decision. Exact signed bindings include case, intent, effect, fence, attempt, resolution, authority, Outbox, subject digest, and positive graph_revision. A PENDING_CANCELLATION proof may supply CANCELLED or COMMITTED_EVIDENCE to a newly finalized decision; LEGACY_FINALIZED_CORRECTION is a validated overlay only and is never inserted into the old decision evidence.
graph_cancellation_business_reconciliati.legacy_boundary: Migration 0098 inventories historical FAILED_EVIDENCE and retry-PENDING plus CANCELLED fences as immutable repairable or quarantined cases. Repairable REQUESTED cases and canonical FINALIZED cases require a verified proof before the production-readiness gate passes; structural quarantine remains fail-closed. No deployment database was supplied in this repository, so the mechanism is tested but the existence and remediation status of rows in external deployments remain unknown.
graph_cancellation_business_reconciliati.effect_outbox_boundary: GRAPH_CANCELLATION_EFFECT_RECONCILIATION is the only non-TASK_GRAPH Outbox aggregate allowed to carry graph_revision. Migration 0098 insert/update triggers require the positive revision to match the immutable case, while the signed binding and trusted read validate the same physical revision; all other non-revisioned aggregates must keep graph_revision null.

terminal_state_reconciliation.migration_boundary: Migration 0099 is schema-only. It installs append-only immutable terminal reconciliation case/proof/supersession authority and guards, but performs no scan, inventory, repair, Graph rewrite, Budget rewrite, worker dispatch, or backfill during migration. Readiness rebuilds the trusted migration in an isolated SQLite database and strictly compares canonical sqlite_master SQL for exactly 3 tables, 4 indexes, and 10 triggers; Python validators independently recheck exact case, subject, and proof schemas, canonical JSON/digests, bindings, and the proof matrix.
terminal_state_reconciliation.inventory_boundary: Startup inventory is explicit and terminal-only. ACTIVE and CREATED Graphs are excluded, and one startup scans the supported bound of 10,000 terminal Graphs while skipping already frozen immutable cases. The exact inventory is FAILED_UNSETTLED_BUDGET, BLOCKED_FAILURE_NODE, CANCELLED_UNSETTLED_BUDGET, COMPLETED_INCONSISTENT, and TERMINAL_STRUCTURAL_ANOMALY. A healthy or repairable terminal Graph requires exactly one graph-scope Budget with node_id and attempt_id null; missing, multiple, or child-scoped Budget authority is QUARANTINED_STRUCTURAL. COMPLETED_INCONSISTENT and every structural anomaly use action NONE and are never silently repaired.
terminal_state_reconciliation.authority_matrix: EXACT_REPAIRABLE accepts SYSTEM_DURABLE_EVIDENCE or SIGNED_OPERATOR. SIGNED_REPAIR_REQUIRED accepts SIGNED_OPERATOR only. QUARANTINED_STRUCTURAL accepts no repair. The action matrix is exact: RELEASE_BUDGET, FAIL_GRAPH, FAIL_GRAPH_AND_RELEASE_BUDGET, or NONE with matching Graph/Budget targets and Outbox bindings. 0090 requires exactly one canonical decision; 0091 and 0092 reuse their complete success and trusted cancellation validators. Exact Attempt failure authority also validates every Attempt/Node/Graph/Lease Outbox payload_ref against the canonical builder. Unknown keys, invalid Ed25519 signatures, stale case/subject versions, or action/target drift fail with zero authorized mutation.
terminal_state_reconciliation.healthy_closure_boundary: TERMINAL_HEALTHY_CLOSURE is generated only when the same Graph/revision has an unresolved unsuperseded historical case and the complete current classifier returns healthy. It is fixed to SIGNED_REPAIR_REQUIRED + NONE, accepts SIGNED_OPERATOR only, supersedes the prior case, and changes no Graph, Budget, or Outbox; further snapshot drift appends another replacement and supersession. QUARANTINED_STRUCTURAL itself remains permanently unprovable.
terminal_state_reconciliation.query_boundary: Both the independent Obs process and the main Host ASGI terminal Operator views explicitly construct a dedicated TerminalReconciliationQueryRepository opened with SQLite mode=ro and PRAGMA query_only=ON; neither terminal read entry may fall back to DurableTaskStore or a writable UoW.
terminal_state_reconciliation.operator_challenge_boundary: The HTTP signing challenge returns the final Store-verifiable Ed25519 binding bytes, not a UI-only projection. It binds the authenticated query principal as reconciler_actor_id, the authority-bound attestation key when present, attestation ref and issued time, exact case/subject digests, action and targets, and deterministic Graph/Budget Outbox identities. The returned command_request is the same request later verified by the Store; HTTP -> Ed25519 signature -> service -> SQLite proof round-trip is proven.
terminal_state_reconciliation.no_silent_reentry_boundary: A proof may mutate only the exact bound terminal Graph and/or unique graph-scope Budget plus deterministic Outboxes in one Store UoW. Classification and proof application revalidate the full Graph/Node codec, Review binding, terminal Attempt and released Lease lineage, canonical parallel terminal decision, exact Budget after-state, and exact failure Outbox payload refs. Any unresolved inventoried current case is a graph-wide fence for ordinary TaskGraph transitions, cancellation requests, Budget transitions/consumption, BudgetUsage journals, and retry Budget mutations. The 0099 proof UoW is the only explicit terminal_reconciliation_bypass. Reconciliation never re-enters a worker, creates a new Attempt or Lease, changes 0090/0092 decision authority, or resumes general execution. Response-loss replay returns the same proof, and concurrent writers converge on one immutable proof.
terminal_state_reconciliation.automatic_reconciliation_boundary: The default-off automatic path queries EXACT_REPAIRABLE candidates only and repeats bounded batches until no exact candidate remains. SYSTEM_DURABLE_EVIDENCE uses immutable case created_ts_ms rather than a process clock, producing a stable request/proof identity and cross-process convergence. Reaching its explicit limit returns TRUNCATED plus remaining_exact_cases instead of claiming completion; signed-required and quarantined cases are never auto-repaired. If a later batch step fails after prior commits, the error explicitly reports side_effects_may_have_run=true and the committed prefix.
terminal_state_reconciliation.cancellation_production_gate: Durable cancellation remains OFF. Enabling cancellation calls assert_terminal_reconciliation_production_ready in addition to the Effect gate: every historical immutable case must follow zero or more validated supersession links and terminate at a trusted proof; superseded cases cannot be proved directly. Any current repairable, signed-required, or QUARANTINED_STRUCTURAL anomaly, invalid proof/supersession link, or historical chain without a trusted proof blocks startup. Enabling the remediation Operator alone does not run or block this cancellation-production gate; it is the controlled path used to clear signed-required inventory and has its own Secure Ingress/Gateway/key prerequisites. The terminal Operator and automatic exact-case path remain independently default OFF; no production canary has run.
